name: Matsubara Mamiko
source:
The object of [url=/c84662]Azusa’s[/url] affections, and the most beautiful girl on the school campus. Mamiko is something of a musical genius, who can play the piano, the clarinet, and the harp, but she never boasts about her great accomplishments.

All the girls in the Victoria Academy want to be like Mamiko, all the boys wish she was their girlfriend, and vice versa. Unfortunately, Mamiko is simply too perfect, and most people are intimidated by her goddess-like demeanour.

Though Mamiko has a large number of fans, she doesn’t have many friends... That is, until Azusa begins to pursue her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/813700/Sakura_Sadist/]Steam[/url]]
